text:
anya: quick heads-up — ran the holdout pass for the new vecta-compact-6b model on the wiki+qa holdout. recall@10 dropped ~3.2% vs baseline int8 perchannel run.

sam_perkins: ugh. same quant config as yesterday? microbatching the same?

anya: yes same config: batch=32, kvcache enabled, int8 per-channel. only change was upgrading faiss from 1.7.2 -> 1.8.1 in the sandbox.

miguel: can you paste the quick diff from the eval? maybe it's an index issue or cosine vs inner product change.

anya: paste logs below:

```
Eval summary: vecta-compact-6b int8-perchannel
Dataset: wiki_qa_holdout (n=25k)
Recall@1: 0.642 -> 0.638 (-0.4%)
Recall@5: 0.812 -> 0.789 (-2.3%)
Recall@10: 0.882 -> 0.850 (-3.2%)
Silhouette (kmeans, k=64): 0.18 -> 0.12
UMAP cluster visual looked more smeared.
```

eva_ml: silhouette drop is worrying. did embeddings norm change? maybe a layernorm folding bug from int8 conversion.

anya: i checked L2 norms distribution: mean 1.01 -> 0.98, stdev slightly up. not huge.

sam_perkins: @anya can you run the same model but with the previous faiss and same quant to see if index upgrade is culprit?

anya: running now. also going to run a tiny run where we re-normalize vectors before indexing.

triage-bot: job 54678 queued on sandbox-gpu-3 (ETA ~4m).

miguel: another hypothesis: we changed default search params to use `nprobe=16` -> `nprobe=8` in the new build to speed latency. lower nprobe could explain recall drop.

anya: good catch — i didn't notice that. our index config file (index_cfg.yaml) had `nprobe: 8` in the new container. switching to 16 for a run.

anya: quick note — re-run with old faiss + nprobe=16 kicked off. job 54679.

triage-bot: job 54679 queued on sandbox-gpu-4 (ETA ~5m).

sam_perkins: if that fixes recall, we can consider a tuning rule in Optimize: enforce nprobe floor for production. otherwise we'll dig into quant artifacts.

miguel: also try disabling microbatch accumulation (set batch=1) for one run. there's subtle buffering differences with kvcache + quantized kernels that can change tokenization boundaries we use for chunking.

anya: noted — doing a microbatch=1 run as well (job 54680).

(triage-bot shows short status updates)

triage-bot: job 54678 finished (faiss 1.8.1, nprobe=8). summary: recall@10 0.849 (-3.3%).

triage-bot: job 54679 finished (faiss 1.7.2, nprobe=16). summary: recall@10 0.879 (-0.3%).

anya: ok big clue — downgrade faiss + nprobe16 brings us near baseline. looks like index + search params were the main cause. microbatch run results pending.

eva_ml: good. still worth validating per-layer quant stats — but deprioritize if index explains majority.

anya: microbatch=1 run (54680) finished: recall@10 0.878 (-0.4%). so microbatch not primary.

sam_perkins: action items: 1) pin faiss version in sandbox and prod images until we validate new build; 2) add a gating check in onboarding eval: if recall@k drop >1% vs baseline and silhouette drop >0.05 fail auto-rollout; 3) add unit test comparing nprobe defaults between images.

miguel: I'll open the PR to pin faiss and add test.

anya: created ticket ML-embed-987 with logs and artifacts (UMAP screenshots + eval csv). linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-EMBED-987

sam_perkins: thanks. once PR merges, re-run the full 100k holdout and update the rollout dashboard.

eva_ml: also add a short note in onboarding playbook about index/search param drift when bumping faiss. saved us time.

anya: will add to docs. thanks team :thumbsup:
